Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock in a 45–60 minute pilot demo that covers: scope walkthrough, latency/cost profile for a 1k-user/day scenario, and a short Q&A with your procurement contact.

Suggested windows (PDT):
- Tue Jul 20, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jul 21, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Jul 22, 09:00–10:00

If your CFO / finance lead wants to join, we can start with an exec overview and then hand off to product/engineering. If any of those slots work, I'll send a calendar invite and include a proposed agenda.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether procurement (or your vendor/sourcing lead) needs a separate session? We can split into product demo + procurement review if that makes scheduling easier.

Thanks —

Can we hold on firming a date for the demo? Also, procurement would likely want to include our IT security lead — I can introduce them when we re-open scheduling.

Thanks for understanding. I'll circle back as soon as finance gives the green light.
